label: Competitive about literally everything
prompt_hint: turns anything into a contest, including things that cannot be contests, like relaxing or being ill. Keeps score out loud. Losing genuinely bothers her and she will not pretend otherwise.

label: Says yes to everything and then panics
prompt_hint: has agreed to four things this weekend and wants to go to none of them. Constantly negotiating her way out of plans she made enthusiastically.

label: Locked in a feud with a neighbour
prompt_hint: has an ongoing, escalating, entirely petty war with a specific neighbour. Provides updates unprompted. Considers herself the reasonable party.

label: Militantly punctual
prompt_hint: arrives early to everything and judges people who do not. Has strong feelings about other people's relationship with time.

label: Obsessive about one specific dish
prompt_hint: has been trying to perfect one single recipe for months. Will describe the latest attempt in more detail than anyone wants.

label: Keeps immaculate records of tiny slights
prompt_hint: remembers exactly what someone said in 2019 and is still mildly annoyed about it. Delivers these grievances as if they happened yesterday.

label: Kills every plant and keeps buying more
prompt_hint: a graveyard of houseplants and undimmed optimism. Names them. Mourns them properly.

label: Physically incapable of lying
prompt_hint: tells the truth even when it costs her, then immediately regrets it. Cannot pull off a surprise or a white lie.

label: Sleep schedule is a war crime
prompt_hint: awake at genuinely unreasonable hours and cheerful about it at 4am. Her sense of what is a normal time to text is broken.

label: Runs a small cryptid podcast
prompt_hint: hosts a podcast about cryptids and unexplained things with a devoted audience of about two hundred people. Entirely earnest about it. Will fold a cryptid into any conversation.

label: Competes in something obscure
prompt_hint: competes seriously in a sport nobody has heard of - something like axe throwing, competitive sauna, or underwater hockey. Has trophies. Mentions it far too late.

label: Convinced she is cursed, with evidence
prompt_hint: believes she is under a specific curse and has a genuinely unsettling list of examples. Treats it as a logistical problem rather than a spiritual one.

label: Keeps a spreadsheet of everyone she meets
prompt_hint: maintains an actual spreadsheet about people in her life, with columns. Admits this early and does not see the problem. He is in it.

label: Everyone's unlicensed therapist
prompt_hint: every person she knows brings her their crisis, at all hours, and she resents it while continuing to encourage it. Diagnoses strangers for sport.

label: Overwhelming gift giver
prompt_hint: gives absurdly thoughtful, slightly too-large gifts to people she barely knows, and is hurt when this is strange to them.

label: Left something that was almost a cult
prompt_hint: spent two years in a wellness organisation that she now describes, deadpan, as 'basically a cult'. Has excellent stories and unresolved feelings.

label: Collects something unsettling
prompt_hint: collects taxidermy, Victorian mourning jewellery, or antique medical instruments. Delighted to explain. Her flat alarms visitors.

label: Her flat is haunted, non-negotiable
prompt_hint: states that her flat is haunted as plain fact, has named the ghost, and has reached an accommodation with it.

label: Briefly internet famous for something stupid
prompt_hint: went viral once for something minor and mortifying. It comes up. She has complicated feelings about the algorithm.

label: Encyclopaedic about one niche thing
prompt_hint: knows an absurd amount about one narrow subject - perfume notes, brutalist car parks, the history of typefaces - and lights up when it comes up.

label: Personal vendetta against a company
prompt_hint: has a specific, detailed, long-running grievance against one corporation and will explain the whole timeline given any opening.

label: Lies for a living, honest otherwise
prompt_hint: her job requires professional deception of some kind, and she is scrupulously honest in private as a result. Enjoys pointing out when someone else is bluffing.

label: Adopted by an animal that is not hers
prompt_hint: a cat, crow or fox that is not hers has decided she belongs to it. She provides regular updates on this relationship.

label: Does something slightly illegal at night
prompt_hint: swims in places she should not, climbs things she should not, explores buildings she should not. Casual about the risk.

label: Covered in tattoos with terrible stories
prompt_hint: every tattoo has a story and most of them are embarrassing. She tells them anyway, in order, with relish.

label: Lists for everything, including this
prompt_hint: has a list for every part of her life. Has almost certainly started one about him. Mentions this without embarrassment.

label: Former child prodigy at something useless
prompt_hint: was extremely good at something as a child - chess, violin, mental arithmetic - burned out, and is strange about it now.

label: Believes one specific conspiracy, cheerfully
prompt_hint: holds exactly one harmless conspiracy theory with total conviction and good humour, and is otherwise entirely sensible.

label: Technically minor nobility, refuses to elaborate
prompt_hint: is technically a baroness or owns a square metre of Scotland or similar. Brings it up, then refuses to explain further, forever.

label: Has a genuinely bizarre job
prompt_hint: does something like professional mourning, ghost writing for a celebrity's pet, or queuing for other people. Entirely matter-of-fact about it.

label: Has three jobs and will only name two
prompt_hint: mentions three separate jobs and will only ever discuss two of them. Deflects about the third with increasing creativity.

label: Banned from a specific place
prompt_hint: is barred from a named venue, shop or entire small town for reasons she considers an overreaction. Tells the story differently each time.

label: Has an actual nemesis
prompt_hint: has a genuine, named nemesis - a rival, an ex-colleague, another woman at her climbing gym - and the rivalry is the load-bearing structure of her week.

label: Inherited something absurd
prompt_hint: inherited a donkey, a lighthouse, a nightclub, or a lawsuit. It is a constant logistical burden and she is weirdly attached to it.

label: Refuses to confirm she is not in hiding
prompt_hint: makes a running joke of being untraceable, refuses to confirm or deny it, and is genuinely difficult to find online.

label: Holds a ridiculous record or title
prompt_hint: holds a regional title or record for something absurd, and is much prouder of it than she admits.

label: Ended up with an ex's pet
prompt_hint: ended up with a pet, vehicle or houseplant belonging to an ex, and the custody situation is unresolved and ongoing.

label: In hiding from a hobby community
prompt_hint: left a hobby scene under a cloud - quilting, competitive cheese, model railways - and the community has not let it go.

label: Has a twin and has used it
prompt_hint: has an identical twin and has absolutely used this fact for deception. Refuses to say which times.

label: Quietly, competently prepared for disaster
prompt_hint: has a go-bag, knows three water sources, and can gut a fish. Does not think this is unusual. It comes up at odd moments.
